title: nhrp: dissector updated and registered in Ethertype
description:
packet-nhrp.c updated to have dissection for ipv6 addresses: added new items for
proto_tree, addresses are checked to have length of 16 bytes. The dissector
is now registered in Ethertype table too and has code 0x2001 like in GRE.
For this reason CGMP dissector is registered under the code 0x2000 also like
in GRE. Files besides packet-nhrp.c have only chanded in codes, packet-ethertype
has nhrp as a new element in the table etype_vals.

notes.body: Made a new request but there are still three commits because of merges. I chose to squash them after accepting but merge ones don't seem to be readable

added 7 commits
  • 460545ea...de27688c - 6 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • b7d6c4f2 - nhrp: dissector updated and registered in Ethertype
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/20179/diffs?diff_id=1389062457&start_sha=460545ea237c9b5b9bdf0e5e0f894384fdac30da)

Rebased (NOT merged) the changes off of master and was able to get it down to a single commit.  I tried the same for the original MR, but didn't have permission (could be because other users weren't allowed to change MR).  However, we like keeping the history of discussions with MRs (and there were good discussions there), so please push this to the original branch (will require a force push).

Closing this MR.

@@ -99,6 +99,7 @@ const value_string etype_vals[] = {
 	{ ETHERTYPE_DEC_LAST,             "DEC LAST" },
 	{ ETHERTYPE_ETHBRIDGE,            "Transparent Ethernet bridging" },
 	{ ETHERTYPE_CGMP,                 "Cisco Group Management Protocol" },
+	{ ETHERTYPE_NHRP,                 "NHRP" },
 	{ ETHERTYPE_GIGAMON,              "Gigamon Header" },
 	{ ETHERTYPE_MSRP,                 "802.1Qat Multiple Stream Reservation Protocol" },
 	{ ETHERTYPE_MMRP,                 "802.1ak Multiple Mac Registration Protocol" },

@@ -100,7 +100,11 @@ extern "C" {
 #endif
 
 #ifndef ETHERTYPE_CGMP
-#define ETHERTYPE_CGMP			0x2001
+#define ETHERTYPE_CGMP			0x2000
+#endif
+
+#ifndef ETHERTYPE_NHRP
+#define ETHERTYPE_NHRP			0x2001
 #endif
 
 #ifndef ETHERTYPE_GIGAMON
